name: quki-notes
description: QuKi Notes — quick-capture notes app (Android, Windows, Linux).

scripts.test:e2e:electron: npm run build && npm run --prefix electron build && node e2e/electron.e2e.ts && node e2e/send.e2e.ts && node e2e/exportElectron.e2e.ts && node e2e/hangingIndentElectron.e2e.ts
scripts.test:e2e:electron:setup: npm run build && npm run --prefix electron build && node e2e/electronSetup.e2e.ts
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run --prefix electron build
scripts.electron:start: npm run electron:build && npm run --prefix electron start
scripts.electron:dev: npm run --prefix electron build && node scripts/electron-dev.mjs
scripts.capacitor:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
